title: Friends with Health Benefits: A Field Experiment
authors: Rachel Gershon; Cynthia E. Cryder; Katherine L. Milkman
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with a common intervention period (four-week Gym Bonus month for all participants). All.R estimates feols(visits ~ treat:intervention [+ treat:post, frequency/incentive interactions] | p + week, cluster = buddy), comparing tandem-reward with standard-reward arms over the same weeks. One treatment date, no staggered adoption; the secondary models add triple interactions.
design_notes: R (fixest). Person-week gym-visit panel (main_data.xlsx) plus pilot data and three Qualtrics surveys.
data_files_note: README.docx: raw data for the main study, pilot and three surveys, with a data dictionary.
data_provenance_note: Experimental data collected by the authors, shipped as raw files.
screener_notes: Screened from README, All.R and OpenAlex abstract. RCT with common timing; not a staggered design.
